display.purpose: Monumental hero statements with quiet weight and balanced wrapping.

headline.purpose: Major section statements sharing the display rhythm.

title.purpose: Collection item names aligned opposite compact category labels.

body.purpose: Sparse supporting copy and form status messages.

label.purpose: Uppercase form labels, controls, and compact actions.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: All state, navigation, and reveal transitions.

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Button, icon, and direct state feedback.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Image reveals, settling, and collection image crops.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Effectively removes animation and transitions when reduced motion is preferred.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single cobalt action used in the hero and quote form.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 54px; padding: 0 25px; border: 1px solid #234a83; border-radius: 2px; font: 680 0.78rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-button-primary { color: #f8f7f3; background: #234a83; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #193b6b; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #234a83; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Quote Field
components.description: A square, underlined field integrated into the plaster surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 9px; color: #2a2f28; font: 650 0.78rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 0; color: #2a2f28; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2f28; border-radius: 0; font: 400 1rem/1.7 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #234a83; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Compact uppercase navigation with a slow cobalt underline reveal.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 40px; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 14px 0; color: #2a2f28; text-decoration: none; font: 630 0.75rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.09em; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: 7px; height: 1px; background: #234a83; transition: right 420ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { right: 0; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #234a83; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Collection Item
components.description: A flat editorial product figure reduced to category and name.
components.css: .ds-card { width: min(100%, 560px); color: #2a2f28; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-image { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; background: #d6d0c5; } .ds-card-copy { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 20px 0 64px; } .ds-card-copy p, .ds-card-copy h3 { margin: 0; } .ds-card-copy p { color: #234a83; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 680; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-card-copy h3 { font-size: 1.55rem; font-weight: 520; }

components.name: Brand Lockup
components.description: The open-center three-stroke mark paired with the tracked TAHANIVO wordmark.
components.html: TAHANIVO
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: fit-content; color: #2a2f28; text-decoration: none; font: 620 1.05rem/1.2 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.22em; } .ds-brand svg { width: 34px; height: 34px; } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #234a83; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
TAHANIVO treats furniture as an object to be examined, not merchandise to be crowded by interface chrome. A monumental close crop, broad plaster fields, weathered timber, and disciplined whitespace create a calm editorial storefront with enough product substance to support online evaluation.

The system is luxurious through distillation: one sans-serif family, two pale neutrals, fine rules, flat controls, and a single cobalt action voice. The path is deliberately narrow—view the collection, understand the craft, request a quote—and whitespace replaces explanatory copy wherever the images and headings can carry meaning. The current catalog and imagery establish direction rather than final product truth; pricing, payment, fulfillment, and remote quote submission remain intentionally unconnected.
keyCharacteristics: Monumental furniture imagery balanced by open plaster space.
Flat, square-edged controls and containers divided by hairline rules.
Charcoal-green typography with cobalt reserved for actions and orientation.
Modern variable sans typography with quiet scale, terse copy, and compact uppercase labels.
Controlled motion: quick feedback, slow image settling, and no bounce.
A three-stroke open-center mark paired with a widely tracked wordmark.

rules.name: The One Cobalt Voice Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for action, focus, and small orientation cues; do not turn it into a broad decorative field.

rules.name: The Material Neutral Rule
rules.body: Surfaces should feel like plaster, timber, upholstery, and bronze rather than pure white, pure black, or cool gray.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Create hierarchy with Hanken Grotesk's variable weight, scale, case, and tracking; do not introduce a display serif or decorative face.

rules.name: The Quiet Scale Rule
rules.body: Large headings stay medium-light, tightly tracked, and nearly solid-set; never compensate for scale with heavy weight.

rules.name: The Presence Before Density Rule
rules.body: Preserve furniture scale and open ground as columns collapse; do not solve mobile by shrinking the product into a thumbnail or compressing section rhythm.

rules.name: The No Floating Chrome Rule
rules.body: Cards and controls sit directly on the page; use crop, tone, and fine rules instead of shadows or raised containers.

rules.name: The Open-Center Mark Rule
rules.body: Use the supplied two-dimensional three-stroke asset without redrawing it as a letterform, monogram, filled badge, or ornamental seal.

dos: Do let one substantial furniture crop command the opening composition.
Do use restrained cobalt for actions, keyboard focus, status, and small orientation cues.
Do preserve the 44px minimum menu target, semantic landmarks, visible focus, descriptive product alt text, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do preserve the distilled path from collection to craft to quote.
Do label provisional catalog content and local-only quote behavior honestly until backend services exist.
Do use the supplied three-stroke mark and maintain its open center.
donts: Don't add rounded card chrome, pills, gradients, heavy shadows, glass panels, or decorative borders.
Don't introduce a serif or ornamental display face; hierarchy belongs to Hanken Grotesk's scale and variable weight.
Don't fabricate products, prices, availability, customer claims, fulfillment promises, article publication, or successful remote quote submission.
Don't imply a physical showroom or invite visitors to see products in person.
Don't restore journal, search, account, bag, product-description, secondary-CTA, or explanatory-copy UI until real content or services justify it.
Don't use uncontrolled bounce, parallax, or continuous decorative motion.
